DEFINE exact rational
 delta_(d,m)=d/(2m)*E|A-B|, A,B independent Bin(m,1/d).
THEOREM: C*(d,m,eta)=m IFF eta>=delta_(d,m). This characterizes the entire information-minimum regime, not all values above that floor.

UPPER/WORST-CASE EMPIRICAL EXCESS:
The accepted permutation-equivariant original-row histogram matcher uses exactlymQ/noP and gives entireQ^m, with changedfractionTV(empX,empZ). Set g_m(p,q)=E|Bin(m,p)-Bin'(m,q)|-m|p-q|. Ifp>=q, g=2E[(B-A)+]; monotone binomial coupling in either argument gives g(p,q)<=min{h_m(p),h_m(q)}, h_m(p)=E|Bin(m,p)-Bin'(m,p)|. Same bysymmetry otherwise. Thus for everyP,Q empiricalexcess<=sum_i h_m(p_i)/(2m).
Putu=p(1-p). The integer absolute-value Fourier identity gives
 h_m(p)=(1/pi)*integral_0^pi [1-(1-2u*(1-cos t))^m]/(1-cos t) dt.
For0<=u<=1/4 each integrand is increasing and concave inu (m1 islinear); at t0 use the continuous limit. Composition with concavep(1-p) makes h_m concave inp. Jensen gives sum_i h_m(p_i)<=d*h_m(1/d). Equality occurs atP=Q=uniform[d]. Consequently the EXACT supremum overP,Q of ETV(empX,empZ)-TV(P,Q) is delta_(d,m), not merely a fluctuation upper bound. This proves the theorem's sufficiency with the existing exactjoint matcher, expected finite integer-tie bits/local work and paid oldinput/storage/output.
